feature.title: Thirty-five years on the vendor side of sports and media technology.
feature.text: Olympics, FIFA World Cups, UEFA, the NFL and Formula 1, from the first web team at Deltatre in 1995 to Chief Product & Marketing Officer and Group Chief Evangelist. Since 2023 I advise executive teams, founders and boards on streaming, retention, monetisation and the practical impact of AI. A Guy with a Scarf is where the ideas get tested in public: a weekly newsletter, recorded conversations, published research, a course, and ten live data experiences built from official feeds. LinkedIn Top Voice.

about.big: I work at the intersection of sports, media and technology, helping leaders through the moments where strategy, product and business model collide.
paras: Most of my professional life has been spent on the vendor side, long enough to have seen several cycles repeat themselves with different labels and similar outcomes. The view is pragmatic: innovation grounded in execution, not theory.

I advise companies in this industry, Dolby OptiView and Mercury Intermedia among them, so read the writing as interested rather than neutral. The data experiences I build myself, in the evenings. The scarf is real.

stage_page.title: On stage, online and on air
stage_page.intro: Moderation is preparation. Before a panel I read what each guest has published in the last year, write the questions they have not been asked, and cut the ones they have. On the day the job is to keep the clock, stop the pitch, and let the disagreement happen. Keynotes get the same treatment in reverse: one argument, the numbers that carry it, and the slide count kept low enough that people look at me.
stage_page.offer: Available as moderator, host or keynote speaker for conferences, client events, webinars and podcasts, in English and Italian, remote or in person. Turin is the base; London, Madrid, Düsseldorf and Monaco were the stages of the last twelve months.
